neighbours.label: the quantifying/descriptive word just before an attack or violence noun in news (a massive raid, several bombings, a third wave of violence)
fire: Rebels carried out several bombings in the capital last month.
Officials said the city suffered a massive air raid overnight.
Police made an arrest following a drive-by shooting downtown.
The region saw a third wave of attacks within a single week.
Militants launched a coordinated assault on the border post.
The group claimed a deadly ambush on an army convoy.
Witnesses described a sudden barrage of rockets near the market.
Security forces repelled a fresh offensive in the north.
quiet: Volunteers carried out several cleanups in the capital last month.
Officials said the city enjoyed a massive street party overnight.
Police made an announcement following a meeting downtown.
The region saw a third wave of tourists within a single week.
Engineers launched a coordinated repair of the border road.
The group claimed a narrow victory in the chess final.
Witnesses described a sudden burst of applause near the market.
Shop owners prepared a fresh display in the north.

notes: Card: massive raid, third wave of violence, arrest following drive-by, several bombings, '(' before CNCERT. + pole is print media/newspapers.
